# COMMUNITY-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (CAP) TREATED WITH ORAL ANTIBIOTICS

Empirical regimens listed here cover the usual pathogens associated with CAP,

including atypical pathogens. Specific therapy should be guided by culture

results.

# Diagnosis

Use the CAP Pneumonia Severity Index (PSI) to assist with level of care decision

[CAP Pneumonia Severity Index \(PSI\) Calculator](orz-gtx-abx-cap-psi)

# Previously healthy patients (i.e. no comorbidities):

(WITHOUT chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, diabetes, renal failure,

congestive heart failure, malignancy, alcoholism, asplenia, immunosuppressing

conditions, or use of immunosuppressing drugs)

Preferred:

[Doxycycline 100 mg PO Q12H for 5 days DI](psozid2-pna-doxycycline-100mg-po-bid-5days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-pna-doxycycline-100mg-po-bid-5days)

< OR >

[Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO Q8H for 5 days R](psozid2-pna-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-tid-x5days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-pna-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-tid-x5days)

# Patients with comorbidities:

(WITH chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, diabetes, renal failure, congestive

heart failure, malignancy, alcoholism, asplenia, immunosuppressing conditions or

use of immunosuppressing drugs)

Preferred:

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO Q12H for 5 days R <AND> azithromycin po](orz-set-abx-op-pna-amox-clav-875-125-bid-azith-500-then-250)

once on day 1, then 250 mg PO QDAY for 4 days [M]

[Non-VA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-pna-amox-clav-875-125-bid-azith-500-then-250)

< OR >

[Cefdinir 300 mg PO Q12H for 5 days R <AND> azithromycin once on day 1, then](orz-set-abx-op-pna-cefdinir-300mg-po-bid-azith-500-then-250)

250 mg PO QDAY for 4 days [M]

[Non-VA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-pna-cefdinir-300mg-po-bid-azith-500-then-250)

< OR >

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO Q12H for 5 days R <AND> doxycycline 100](orz-set-abx-op-pna-amox-clav-875-125-bid-doxy-100mg-bid)

mg PO Q12H for 5 days [DI]

[Non-VA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-pna-amox-clav-875-125-bid-doxy-100mg-bid)

< OR >

[Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h for 5 days R <AND> doxycycline 100 mg PO Q12H for 5](orz-set-abx-op-pna-cefdinir-300mg-bid-doxy-100mg-bid)

days [DI]

[Non-VA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-pna-cefdinir-300mg-bid-doxy-100mg-bid)
